changeSet.author: TDuric
changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'ResponsibilityType') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[ResponsibilityType]( [ID] [int] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, [Name] [nvarchar](250) NOT NULL, [ResponsibilityTypeGroup] [int] NULL, [Description] [nvarchar](4000) NULL, [UpdatedOn] [datetime] NULL, [UpdatedBy] [int] NULL, [uid] [uniqueidentifier] CONSTRAINT [DF_ResponsibilityType_uid] DEFAULT (newid()) NOT NULL, [CreatedOn] [datetime] CONSTRAINT [DF_ResponsibilityType_CreatedOn] DEFAULT (getdate()) NOT NULL, [CreatedBy] [int] CONSTRAINT [DF_ResponsibilityType_CreatedBy] DEFAULT (0) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_ResponsibilityType] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_ResponsibilityType_ResponsibilityTypeGroup') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_ResponsibilityType_ResponsibilityTypeGroup] ON [dbo].[ResponsibilityType] ( [ResponsibilityTypeGroup] ASC ) END
if not exists (SELECT * FROM dbo.sysobjects where name = 'UC_ResponsibilityType_uid' and xtype = 'UQ') begin ALTER TABLE [dbo].[ResponsibilityType] ADD CONSTRAINT [UC_ResponsibilityType_uid] UNIQUE(uid) end
changeSet.rollback: if exists (SELECT * FROM dbo.sysobjects where name = 'UC_ResponsibilityType_uid' and xtype = 'UQ') begin ALTER TABLE [dbo].[ResponsibilityType] DROP CONSTRAINT [UC_ResponsibilityType_uid] end
